subject: [PATCH v6 09/19] selftests/mm: add folio-order detection self-check

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a self-test to verify the accuracy of the vm_util folio-order helpers, which are used by khugepaged mTHP tests to detect collapse results. The test faults in memory with only one order enabled at a time and checks that the helpers report exactly that order. The test is run ahead of the khugepaged test to ensure that any errors are reported as themselves rather than as collapse failures.
